summary.text: Nancy Aichholz is a Republican candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 27 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democrat Rachel Baker is the incumbent.
She previously held an at-large position with the Indian Hill Exempted Village School District, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Aichholz was the Republican nominee for Hamilton County Auditor in 2018, after advancing unopposed from the May 8, 2018 Republican primary.
She lost the November 6, 2018 general election to incumbent Dusty Rhodes, 65.2 percent to 34.8 percent.
